selection: Generated by scripts/select-demo-borrower.ts, which runs the page engine (lib/position-sim runComparison) over every evidence row and ranks by: (1) Membrane SURVIVES — no collateral-seizing liquidation and the 4% window never broke, so cure and recall only; (2) the largest equityDeltaUsd, the exact figure the hero prints; (3) the latest first Aave liquidation. Eligible: mainnet (protocols.json is a mainnet read, so its risk parameters and the token addresses only apply there); a single collateral leg priced by the measured path AND present in protocols.json aaveV3.reserves; debt priced or a $1 stable held flat; collateralUsd $50k-$3M (no whales); and the first Aave liquidation at least 60 minutes into the path, so the hero is not a minute-0 artifact. Run with the ASSUMED deployment below (50% of the measured debt at recall 0.6 / fast 0.55), the page's default liquidation fee matched to Aave's own bonus, and the measured median repay fraction. 63 rows qualified; 49 survive on Membrane with the deployment and this one won at $7,596 — the only survivor that also ends AHEAD of Aave on equity. Stress 35%/0.60: 3 survive, this wallet survives at $7,596. Stress 50%/0.40: 2 survive, this wallet survives at $7,596. WITHOUT a deployment, 0 of the 63 survive: Membrane's modelled line sits under Aave's for every eligible collateral (WETH 80% vs 83%, WBTC 75% vs 78%), so Membrane breaches first and with nothing to recall the 8h cure window can never fire. That is why the deployment is assumed rather than measured — see assumedDeployment.note.

assumedDeployment.note: ASSUMED, not measured. This wallet had no deployment — Aave liquidated it and the borrowed dollars were gone. Half its measured debt is placed in a venue modelled at 60% recall / 55% inside the 8-hour window — the same rates the carry worked example uses. Why assume one at all: partial liquidation is no longer the differentiator (Aave V4 has it too). What differs is the RECALL RAILS — venue capital deployed out of the debt answers the margin call inside the 4% window and nothing is sold. With no deployment none of the 63 eligible wallets survives on Membrane, so a rails page needs a wallet with rails. The page is a counterfactual either way; this is one more labelled clause of it. The deployment is counted on BOTH balance sheets, so it buys Membrane the recall and nothing else. Break-even: the wallet still survives down to a 36% recall rate.
